what: When the heading enters the screen, the letters drop from an arc that is higher on the right (−60 + 200·sin), back letters first (1s expo.inOut, after .5s·1s), and a bird flies past in 2s along a curve from upper right to lower left, turning its body −55°→55°. A thin curve is drawn in its wake over 1.8s, erased 1s later from the opposite end, and the bird vanishes in .4s

options.dur: Bird flight duration (seconds), default 2 — text and line lengths follow this ratio
options.delay: Delay before characters start rising (s), default .5
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top bottom (as soon as visible)
options.[data-fx-part=bird]: Flying bird (child) — if absent, the part inserts a default bird image. Size is 2.64× and 3.33× the font size
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Child to split the text — if none, the element’s own text

note: The bird’s path (offset-path) and line are a fixed 820×221px curve like the original — if the title is very small, data-fx-part=Put the bird in directly and use css to shorten the offset-path

from.where: shared.js section title · .ns-title (twelve sections on the first page·subpage header titles)
